reuse.why: Writes Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075) by hand twice instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold in shared/rules.ts, and adds no shared expected-amount function.

duplication.why: The same approximate-amount ternary is pasted into both api-models.ts and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, alongside already-duplicated range logic in each.

placement.why: The rule is embedded inline in an API mapper and in the preview function rather than defined once in shared/schedules.ts, where the tree keeps schedule amount helpers.

scope.why: Edits stay on the approximate rule and its tests, though only two of the paths that compute a schedule's amount are touched.

maintainability.why: Nested ternaries with a magic 0.075 constant in two places that must track the matching tolerance by hand; the next rule change has to find every copy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal and shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions re-derive the tolerance instead of using getApproxNumberThreshold (shared/rules.ts).

disguised_duplication.where: The copies are verbatim inline ternaries in api-models.ts and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, not reshaped.

one_place.where: The approximate rule is written separately in scheduleModel.toExternal (server/api-models.ts) and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions (shared/schedules.ts); other amount paths (getScheduledAmount, posting, forecast, templates) do not get it.
